style: ComfyUI-regenerated classic early-2000s JRPG fantasy asset set: warm hand-painted anime color, crisp top-down silhouettes, transparent PNG assetization, and higher-resolution player direction sheets.
notes: Generated through D:/project/xianxia-art-lab ComfyUI workflows and packed by tools/vsg_comfy_pack_art.py.
Player movement follows the requested chain: front source, 360 turntable, 8 direction frames, 8 directional walk videos, selected animation frames.
Non-player PNGs are derived from ComfyUI source images per logical asset, then packed to the existing manifest paths, keys, frame sizes, and frame counts.
Transparent RGBA output is used for sprites, icons, VFX, enemies, props, pickups, and UI; terrain tiles intentionally fill the full canvas.

playerWalkStandard.cropPolicy: Each high-resolution source cell is isolated on transparency, scaled into the declared frame, horizontally centered, and feet-aligned to preserve the original action timing.
